intro: In the 4 official DSSSB TGT Computer Science papers of 2023–24 there were {n} DSA questions, about 3–4 per paper. They are mostly definitions and complexity facts: characteristics of an algorithm, order of growth, best/average/worst cases of sorting, divide and conquer, backtracking (sum of subsets), queue operations and graph degrees. Memorise the complexity tables, then practise the short numericals.
